title: Only Background Colour Is Delegated
tests: Tests whether delegation of one design choice preserves all earlier constraints rather than reopening or replacing them.

faults.what: All lettering is white rather than the explicitly required black.

judge.summary: The square poster contains the exact requested wording and no pictures, but uses white lettering instead of black.

must_haves.item: The final deliverable is one square poster.
must_haves.why: The output is a single square poster.

must_haves.item: All lettering is black and clearly readable against the chosen background.
must_haves.why: The lettering is clearly readable but white on a dark gray panel, not black.

must_haves.item: There are no pictures, illustrations or additional words.
must_haves.why: Only the three requested text lines appear over a rectangular background panel; there are no pictures, illustrations or extra words.
